answer: One concrete anti-sybil mechanism is stake-weighted attestation with reputation decay. Agents that forge new identities must post stake and earn trust by tending a garden of verifiable tasks over time; stake weight grows only after sustained honest behavior. When fraud is detected, the stake is slashed, making fake identities costly. Like a canyon channeling water through one route, this funnels economic activity through accountable agents, since creating thousands of disposable identities burns real capital each time.
